Pneumatic Flow Simulator

Component

Pressures

Gauge pressures; negative = vacuum. Air flows from the higher to the lower side.
Temperature of the air on the upstream (high-pressure) side.

Orifice

Effective flow area = Cd × hole area. Typical values; measure the real part for accuracy.

Tube

Drawn PU / nylon tubing ≈ 1.5 µm; 3D-printed channels 10-50 µm.
Adiabatic: short or fast flows, choked at Mach 1. Isothermal: long thin tubes, choked at Mach 0.85. Reality is in between.
Entrance, bends, fittings: added to f·L/D. 0.5 = sharp tube entrance.
